name: Kabosu’s Christmas recovery
description:
Kabosu’s Christmas recovery
On Christmas Eve 2022, Kabosu—then 17 years old—became seriously ill and could not eat or drink on her own. Her owner, Atsuko Sato, took her to the hospital on Christmas Day, where vets diagnosed acute cholangiohepatitis and chronic lymphoma leukemia.

It looked frightening at first: her liver values were very poor and she had jaundice. But after treatment with antibiotics, Kabosu began to improve, regained her appetite, and was able to drink water again.
